Congress wins Datia bypoll, defeats BJP by over 6,000 votes

The Congress party has retained the Datia assembly seat in Madhya Pradesh by defeating the BJP. Ghanshyam Singh of the Congress won the bypoll, defeating the BJP's candidate, identified as Tiwari in one report, by a margin of over 6,000 votes. Celebrations involving firecrackers and sweets were reported by Congress workers. The bypoll was considered a prestige battle, with one report noting a divided Congress managed to outperform the BJP.
